note: Primitive USFS campground on Citico Creek, Cherokee NF (Tellico Ranger District); each site has a picnic table, fire ring/grill and lantern post, and a host holds one site in peak season. Campers report the gravel road passable by ordinary vehicles, sites fairly level, Site 2 best for RVs. Horses not allowed. --Claude
summary: Jake Best: FS page (updated 2025-03-24), the Citico Creek flood alert (2026-10-13) and rec.gov read. $6, 5 people / 2 vehicles, FCFS with Scan and Pay, vault toilets, no water. Open; the flood closed the upstream road (Indian Boundary side) but the campground is reached from Vonore. Season written from the 2025 dates (03-03 to 11-17). Phone set to the Tellico district.
